analyzed_vuln.description: Heap use-after-free in property iteration caused by mutating the same splay-tree being iterated. In WriteMIFFImage(), the code calls SetImageProperty(image,"quantum:format","floating-point",...) and then iterates image properties with ResetImagePropertyIterator/GetNextImageProperty. During the loop, GetImageProperty(property) can invoke GetICCProperty, which calls SetImageProperty on an existing key and reaches AddValueToSplayTree() replacement path. AddValueToSplayTree frees the old key/value for that node and replaces them, but the iterator state (next/key used by GetNextKeyInSplayTree/SplaySplayTree) still references the freed key, later compared in LocaleCompare, triggering UAF.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires an image whose property lookups during MIFF write cause GetImageProperty->GetICCProperty to update an already-present property key/value while WriteMIFFImage is iterating properties. Data flow: fuzzer reads attacker blob into Image (BlobToImage/ReadImage), then writes as MIFF (Image::write -> ImagesToBlob -> WriteMIFFImage). While walking properties, a re-entrant SetImageProperty on the same splay-tree invalidates iterator key pointers; subsequent GetNextImageProperty compares freed key memory and crashes.
